title: Shoulder Coil Turn (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 134bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Shoulder turn shoulder turn before the swing
That is how you store the spring
Shoulder turn shoulder turn ninety degrees
That is the secret to ground force squeeze

[Verse 1]
When the ball is coming on the forehand side
Turn the shoulder away to the wide
Non paddle hand points to the net
The coil is loaded never forget
Vamos vamos turn and load
Shoulder turn the kinetic road
Weight on the back leg ready to push
Shoulder turn through the hush

[Pre-Chorus]
Shoulder turn shoulder turn
Let the kinetic chain learn
Shoulder turn shoulder turn
Ground force gets to earn

[Chorus]
Shoulder turn ninety to the side line
Shoulder turn the energy combine
Shoulder turn legs hips and torso flow
Shoulder turn that is the show
Vamos vamos pa lante
Shoulder turn
Vamos vamos pa lante
Let the energy burn

[Verse 2]
Backhand turn the shoulders go the other way
Shoulder under the chin is what they say
Non paddle hand on the throat of the paddle
The two handed coil wins the battle
Uno dos tres turn and load
Thats the fundamental code
Weight transfer back to forward to the ball
Shoulder turn ground force call

[Bridge]
Common error arming the shot
That is how the swing goes to nought
Use the legs hips and torso first
Shoulder turn quenches the thirst

[Chorus]
Shoulder turn ninety to the side line
Shoulder turn the energy combine
Shoulder turn legs hips and torso flow
Shoulder turn that is the show

[Outro]
Shoulder turn shoulder turn before the swing
That is how you store the spring
Shoulder turn shoulder turn ninety degrees
That is the secret to ground force squeeze
